'''Shanra Immel's squad''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] under the command of [[Republic trooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]. In [[3640 BBY]] Immel's squad was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|invaded and occupied]] the planet. [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] was assigned as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the squad. During the battle the squad was tasked with the destruction of the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]]. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]] was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded during the squad's trek to the spaceport. Ultimately the rest of the squad was successful in the spaceport's destruction.

==Description==
Shanra Immel's squad was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] and was under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]. Known members of the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] include [[Camur]], [[Eron (soldier)|Eron]], [[Yennir of the Green]], [[Vaskus Kayle]], [[Amden vor Keioidian]], [[Min-Reva]], and [[Zenhai]]. [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] personally hand-picked a few squad members specifically for their mission to destroy [[Kalandis Seven]]'s [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==History==
In [[3640 BBY]] Immel's squad was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Kalandis Seven when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|invaded and occupied]] the planet. SpecForce Colonel Jace Malcom was assigned as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the squad. During the battle the squad was tasked with the destruction of the local spaceport. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] Amden vor Keioidian was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded during the squad's trek to the spaceport. Ultimately the rest of the squad was successful in the spaceport's destruction.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shanra Immel's squad was first mentioned within [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' which was released on [[October 2]], [[2012]]. The squad first appeared within [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'' which was published within [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] and released on [[October 23]], 2012.
